message.invalidPlan: The model output does not match a verifiable plan format. No action was provided.
message.commandNotice: This only inserts the command into the terminal bar. It has not been sent; review it and run it manually.
message.editorChanged: The editor changed after the suggestion was generated. Select the buffer again and create a new diff suggestion.
message.applied: Suggestion applied to the local Monaco buffer. The remote file is still unsaved.
message.noEditorContext: The full Monaco buffer was not authorized for this request. The code suggestion cannot be applied.
message.localOnly: This only affects the local buffer. The remote file is not saved automatically.
message.clipboardManual: Clipboard access is unavailable. Select and copy the code manually.
message.commandRestriction: Only a single line without control characters and up to 4 KiB can be inserted. Copy and review multi-line code first.
message.inserted: Inserted into the terminal command bar. Nothing was sent; review it and press Enter manually.
message.insertTitle: Fills the command bar only; it will not be sent to SSH.
